base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: The DisplayPort register space is the DPCD (DisplayPort Configuration Data) in the Sink, accessed by native AUX read/write over the AUX channel (20-bit address). The Source uses it for capability discovery, link configuration, link training, status readback, content protection, and MST. The Sink's EDID is a separate I2C ROM reached by I2C-over-AUX, not part of the DPCD.

router_configuration_space.purpose: USB4 routers expose configuration spaces that the Connection Manager reads/writes to discover capabilities and program paths.

config_space_types.name: Router config space
config_space_types.purpose: Per-router capabilities, topology ID, vendor/product, total adapters.

config_space_types.name: Adapter config space
config_space_types.purpose: Per-adapter type (lane / USB3 / DP-IN / DP-OUT / PCIe), state, capabilities.

config_space_types.name: Path config space
config_space_types.purpose: Per-adapter path entries mapping input hop ID -> output adapter + output hop ID.

adapter_types.name: Lane adapter
adapter_types.purpose: Physical-link endpoint; pairs of lane adapters form an inter-router link (with lane bonding).

adapter_types.name: USB3 adapter
adapter_types.purpose: Up/down adapter that tunnels USB 3.2 traffic.

adapter_types.name: DP-IN adapter
adapter_types.purpose: Ingests DisplayPort source traffic for tunneling.

adapter_types.name: DP-OUT adapter
adapter_types.purpose: Emits tunneled DisplayPort traffic to a sink.

adapter_types.name: PCIe adapter
adapter_types.purpose: Up/down adapter that tunnels PCI Express transactions.

adapter_types.name: Host interface adapter
adapter_types.purpose: Connects the router to its host's Connection Manager.

register_access.transport: Native AUX (Manchester-II, ~1 Mbps) over the AUX channel
register_access.transaction: request (4-bit command + 20-bit address + length) / reply (ACK/NACK/DEFER + data)

fields: MST Sideband MSG buffers (DOWN_REQ / UP_REP / DOWN_REP / UP_REQ)

edid_via_i2c_over_aux.note: EDID is read from the Sink's I2C ROM (I2C address A0h) by tunneling I2C over AUX; it is NOT in the DPCD address space.

aux_command_fields.length_encoding: bytes minus one (1..16 bytes per transaction)
